              Data notes & limitations
              Source principal-stress headers do not explicitly distinguish total and effective stress; mean effective stress and initial effective stress are not inferred. Initial-state values are retained in source metadata; they are not automatically applied because several workbook conditions appear copied between sheets. Original acquisition versus digitization status has not been established for this curve. Post-localization specimen averages are not homogeneous material-point measurements. Volumetric strain withheld from the overlay: source values need independent review; native values remain in the archival record.
